**IHP LECTURES ON HYPERBOLIC 3-MANIFOLDS**

41 pp, 30 sections.

**Abstract.** These notes are designed to accompany my mini-course on hyperbolic 3-manifolds at IHP in May 2025. The goal is to develop enough understanding of hyperbolic 3-manifolds to understand the background statements and some consequences of the Tameness Theorem, the Ending Lamination Theorem and the Density Theorem. The notes contain much more material than we will be able to cover in the actual mini-course.
